desc: Wake up to delicious chocolatey taste by the spoonful. Every bowl of Chocolate Naturally Flavored Cheerios is made with whole grain oats and real cocoa. Beyond the great taste, these little Os can help lower cholesterol* as part of a heart healthy diet. *Three grams of soluble fiber daily from whole grain oat foods, like Chocolate Cheerios Cereal, in a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol, may reduce the risk of heart disease. Chocolate Cheerios Cereal provides .75 grams per serving. Dig into a bowl with milk as a wholesome part of your morning. A serving of this gluten free chocolate flavored whole grain oat cereal provides 21g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), a good source of calcium and fiber, and 12 vitamins and minerals, with no artificial flavors. Beyond a quick and tasty part of breakfast for adults, this cereal makes an easy, gluten free kids snack by the handful. Pack some crispy cereal in a lunch box for a yummy school treat. Or make it an ingredient in your favorite cereal bars recipe. However you enjoy naturally flavored Chocolate Cheerios, it's a part of General Mills cereals, spreading goodness from tots to grown-ups.
features:
NATURALLY FLAVORED CHOCOLATE CHEERIOS: A deliciously chocolatey whole grain oat cereal made with real cocoa; Try this ideal pantry staple as part of a breakfast or snack

CAN HELP LOWER CHOLESTEROL* as part of a heart healthy diet; *3g of soluble fiber daily from whole grain oat foods, in a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol, may reduce the risk of heart disease - Chocolate Cheerios provides .75g per serving

WHOLE GRAIN GOODNESS: Provides 21g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), a good source of calcium and fiber, and 12 vitamins and minerals per serving; No artificial flavors

GLUTEN FREE CEREAL: Pour a bowl with milk for a gluten free part of an easy breakfast; Pack some as gluten free snacks on the go, or add to homemade cereal bars

CONTAINS: One 14.3 oz Large Size box of naturally flavored Chocolate Cheerios Cereal
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Corn Syrup, Corn Starch, Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Salt, Caramel Color, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Tripotassium Phosphate, Natural Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
